image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rough, encrusted rocky surface. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping, textured plates embedded in a fuzzy, brownish girdle. The surrounding rock features patches of pink coralline algae and other marine growth.
